_note: Hover help for AD User Lookup's buttons, menu items and tabs (project-owned, read by Base\Services_ToolTips.psm1). Key = the control's text, optionally preceded by where it is: tab / sub-tab titles (outermost first) or a dialog's title (the part before ' - '), joined with ' > '. The most specific match wins; '&', a trailing '...' and case are ignored. Empty text = no tooltip on purpose. Engine entries (developer buttons, Environment tab, OK / Cancel / Close / Refresh / Export CSV / Export HTML / Copy to Clipboard / Select All / Select None / Stop / Browse) are in the engine; an entry here overrides them. The developer build writes every control still missing one to <data root>\Logs\ToolTips_missing.txt.

ToolTips.User Lookup: Search the directory for a person: name, phone, email, manager. Available with the user password.
ToolTips.Users: Browse the domain by OU, find users, see their groups and act on them from the right-click menu.
ToolTips.Groups: Find groups, see and edit their members.
ToolTips.Account Management: Create a new user (one at a time or from a pasted list).
ToolTips.Computers: Find computers and check connectivity (ping and the RDP / SMB / Radmin / WinRM ports).
ToolTips.Ignition: Discover Ignition gateways on the network with a single HTTP request to each server (no SMB / admin-share access), and open or RDP to them.
ToolTips.Bulk Operations: Actions on many objects at once: delete, add users, add groups, add users to groups, offboard.
ToolTips.Infrastructure: Reports on the domain and forest: functional levels, trusts, DC health, privileged accounts, GPO scope.
ToolTips.Tools: Password generator, naming convention audit, DNS / DHCP lookups, operation log, environment report, abort reboot, ping list.
ToolTips.Audit: Hygiene reports: stale and never-used accounts, locked out, expiring passwords, empty groups and more.
ToolTips.Bulk Operations > Batch Delete: Paste lists of users, computers or groups and delete them (recovery details go in the admin mail).
ToolTips.Bulk Operations > Bulk Add Users: Create many users from a CSV file (template included).
ToolTips.Bulk Operations > Bulk Add Groups: Create many groups from a pasted list, in one OU.
ToolTips.Bulk Operations > Add Users to Groups: Add a pasted list of users to a pasted list of groups.
ToolTips.Bulk Operations > Offboard: Disable, remove groups and move to the disabled OU for a list of leavers.
ToolTips.Infrastructure > Forest / Domain Level: Forest and domain names, functional levels and FSMO role holders.
ToolTips.Infrastructure > Trusts: Every trust of this domain: direction, type, transitivity.
ToolTips.Infrastructure > DC Health: Every domain controller: reachability, services, replication and roles.
ToolTips.Infrastructure > Privileged Accounts: Members of the built-in privileged groups (Domain Admins, Enterprise Admins ...).
ToolTips.Infrastructure > GPO Scope: Which Group Policy Objects apply to an OU.
ToolTips.Tools > Password Generator: Make memorable passwords from the word lists, and edit those lists.
ToolTips.Tools > Naming Convention: Find accounts whose display name, CN or SAM name breaks the naming convention, and fix them.
ToolTips.Tools > DNS Lookup: Resolve a name or address against the domain's DNS servers.
ToolTips.Tools > DHCP Leases: List the leases of a DHCP server.
ToolTips.Tools > Operation Log: Read this environment's action log (every change this app made, by whom and when).
ToolTips.Tools > Environment Report: Scan this machine and the domain connection and report what is installed and reachable.
ToolTips.Tools > Abort Remote Reboot: Paste computer names and cancel a pending restart on each.
ToolTips.Tools > Ping List: Paste computer names and ping them all - once or continuously - with up / down, response time and loss.
ToolTips.Tools > Set DNS: Paste computer names and set their DNS servers on every adapter that is up, over WinRM. Replaces the old Remote DNS Change tool.
ToolTips.Environment > Domain: Domain (DNS name) and domain controller for this environment, with a connection test.
ToolTips.Environment > Accounts: Naming patterns, UPN suffix, home drive and default OUs used when accounts are created or offboarded.
ToolTips.Environment > Mail: SMTP server, port and sender address for notification mail.
ToolTips.Environment > Messages: The New Account Welcome text and the Additional Info messages added to notification mail.
ToolTips.Refresh Tree: Reload the OU tree from the domain.
ToolTips.Clear Scope: Stop limiting the lists to the selected OU - show the whole domain again.
ToolTips.Reload Directory Data: Read all users, groups and computers from the domain again (slower; use after changes made outside this app).
ToolTips.Filter as I type: On: the list re-filters on every keystroke. Off: it filters when you press Enter (better for very large lists).
ToolTips.Users > Export CSV: Save the rows shown in this list to a CSV file (opens in Excel).
ToolTips.Computers > Refresh: Reload the computer list from the domain.
ToolTips.Find Domain Sessions: Search the domain's computers for sessions this user is logged on to (and log them off if needed).
ToolTips.Check Lockout Status: Show lockout state and bad-password counts on every DC, and find which computer caused the lockout.
ToolTips.Reset Password: Set a new password (generated or typed) and optionally require a change at next logon.
ToolTips.Set Account Expiry: Set or clear the date this account stops working.
ToolTips.Edit Groups: Add this user to groups or remove them from groups (or copy another user's groups).
ToolTips.Edit Contacts: Edit phone numbers, email, title, department and manager.
ToolTips.Clone User: Start a new user on the Account Management tab with this user's OU, groups and details filled in.
ToolTips.Unlock Account: Unlock the selected locked-out account(s). Shows the exact command first.
ToolTips.Enable Account: Enable the selected disabled account(s) and stamp the description. Shows the exact command first.
ToolTips.Disable Account: Disable the selected account(s) with a description of why. Shows the exact command first.
ToolTips.Delete User(s): Permanently delete the selected account(s). Shows the exact command first; recovery details go in the admin mail.
ToolTips.Copy Username(s): Copy the selected account names to the clipboard, one per line.
ToolTips.Edit Members: Open the member list of this group: add members, or select and remove them.
ToolTips.Remove User from Group(s): Remove the selected user from the selected group(s). Shows the exact command first.
ToolTips.Delete Group(s): Permanently delete the selected group(s). Shows the exact command first; recovery details go in the admin mail.
ToolTips.Copy Group Name(s): Copy the selected group names to the clipboard, one per line.
ToolTips.Test Connectivity: Ping one computer and test its RDP, SMB, Radmin and WinRM ports (results on the Computers tab cards). For several, use Ping Selected on the Computers tab.
ToolTips.RDP: Open a Remote Desktop connection to each selected computer. Shows the exact command first.
ToolTips.Radmin: Open Radmin Viewer to each selected computer (port 4899). Shows the exact command first.
ToolTips.Ping Selected: (Computers tab, several computers selected) Ping every selected computer in one window - live up / down, response time and loss, every 2 s until Stop.
ToolTips.Ping (continuous, command window): Open a separate command window running ping -t for each selected computer.
ToolTips.Computer Management (MMC): Open Computer Management connected to each selected computer.
ToolTips.BitLocker Recovery Key: Show the BitLocker recovery key(s) stored in AD for this computer.
ToolTips.LAPS Password: Show this computer's local administrator password (Windows LAPS or legacy LAPS) and when it expires.
ToolTips.Show Sessions: List the users logged on to this computer (and log sessions off if needed).
ToolTips.Restart Now: Restart the selected computer(s) immediately, forced. Shows the exact command first.
ToolTips.Timed Restart: Restart the selected computer(s) after a delay, with a message to the logged-on users.
ToolTips.Open C$ Admin Share: Open \\<computer>\c$ in Explorer for each selected computer.
ToolTips.Delete Computer(s): Permanently delete the selected computer object(s). Shows the exact command first.
ToolTips.Copy Computer Name(s): Copy the selected computer names to the clipboard, one per line.
ToolTips.Users > Create User: Start a new user on the Account Management tab with this OU as its target.
ToolTips.Users > Create Group: Create a new group in this OU.
ToolTips.Refresh Items in this OU: Reload the users, groups and computers of this OU.
ToolTips.Clear Scope (show all): Stop limiting the lists to this OU - show the whole domain again.
ToolTips.Create Group > Create: Create the group with the name, scope and type entered.
ToolTips.Ping once: Ping every computer in the list once.
ToolTips.Start continuous: Ping every computer again and again at the chosen interval until you click Stop.
ToolTips.Ping Computers > Stop: Stop pinging. The results so far stay in the list.
ToolTips.Tools > Ping List > Stop: Stop pinging. The results so far stay in the list.
ToolTips.ping -t selected: Open a separate command window running ping -t for each selected row.
ToolTips.Copy results: Copy the whole results table to the clipboard (tab-separated - pastes into Excel).
ToolTips.Tools > Ping List > Clear List: Stop pinging, empty the paste box and the results.
ToolTips.Use naming convention: Build the display name and logon name from first / last name with this environment's naming patterns.
ToolTips.Account Management > Browse: Pick the OU the new user is created in.
ToolTips.Account Management > Create User: Create the account with the values entered (asks to confirm first).
ToolTips.Account Management > Clear: Empty the form to start another user.
ToolTips.Parse: Read the pasted rows into the queue (one user per row) and check each one.
ToolTips.Clear Queue: Empty the queue of pasted users.
ToolTips.Load Selected: Fill the Create User form with the selected queued user, to review and create it.
ToolTips.Skip: Skip this item and go on to the next one.
ToolTips.Delete Users: Delete every account in the list above (asks to confirm first).
ToolTips.Delete Computers: Delete every computer object in the list above (asks to confirm first).
ToolTips.Delete Groups: Delete every group in the list above (asks to confirm first).
ToolTips.Download Template: Save a CSV template with the columns Bulk Add Users expects.
ToolTips.Preview CSV: Read the chosen CSV and show the users it would create, with any problems, before importing.
ToolTips.Import Users: Create every user in the CSV (asks to confirm first).
ToolTips.Bulk Add Users > Browse: Pick the CSV file, or the OU the users are created in.
ToolTips.Create Groups: Create every group in the list, in the chosen OU (asks to confirm first).
ToolTips.Bulk Add Groups > Browse: Pick the OU the groups are created in.
ToolTips.Add to Groups: Add every listed user to every listed group (asks to confirm first).
ToolTips.Run Offboarding: Offboard the listed users: disable, remove group memberships, move to the disabled OU (asks to confirm first).
ToolTips.Offboard > Browse: Pick the OU offboarded accounts are moved to.
ToolTips.Admin Only (summary): Send one summary mail to the admin only.
ToolTips.Individual: Send one mail per account to its own recipients.
ToolTips.Both: Send the admin summary and one mail per account.
ToolTips.Get GPO Scope: List every GPO linked to or inherited by the chosen OU, in order of precedence.
ToolTips.Lookup: Resolve the name or address against the domain's DNS servers.
ToolTips.Get Leases: Read the leases of the DHCP server and scope entered.
ToolTips.Generate: Make new passwords with the current settings.
ToolTips.Tools > Password Generator > Update: Save the edited word list for the password generator.
ToolTips.Tools > Operation Log > Refresh: Read the action log again to show the newest entries.
ToolTips.Open Log Folder: Open the folder holding the logs in Explorer.
ToolTips.Scan Environment: Check this machine (modules, tools, versions) and the domain connection, and show the report.
ToolTips.Abort Pending Restart: Cancel a pending restart on every computer listed. Shows the exact command first.
ToolTips.Scan: Check every account against the naming convention and list the ones that do not match.
ToolTips.Fix Display Name: Rename the selected accounts' display names to the convention. Asks to confirm first.
ToolTips.Fix Canonical Name: Rename the selected accounts' CN (object name) to the convention. Asks to confirm first.
ToolTips.Fix SAM Uppercase: Change the selected accounts' logon names to upper case. Asks to confirm first.
ToolTips.Refresh All: Run every audit report again and update the cards.
ToolTips.Reset Password > Copy: Copy the password to the clipboard.
ToolTips.Password never expires: Set the account's password to never expire.
ToolTips.Reset Password > Reset Password: Set the new password on the account (asks to confirm first).
ToolTips.Set Expiry: Make the account stop working at the end of the chosen date (asks to confirm first).
ToolTips.Clear Expiry: Remove the expiry date - the account never expires (asks to confirm first).
ToolTips.Disable Account > Disable Account: Disable the account(s) with this description (asks to confirm first).
ToolTips.Edit Contacts > Save: Save the changed contact details to AD (asks to confirm first).
ToolTips.Add to Group: Add the user, computer or group entered to this group (asks to confirm first).
ToolTips.Remove Selected Member(s): Remove the selected members from this group (asks to confirm first).
ToolTips.Copy Name(s): Copy the selected names to the clipboard, one per line.
ToolTips.Add Selected to Group(s): Add the user to the groups selected on the right (asks to confirm first).
ToolTips.Remove from Group(s): Remove the user from the selected groups (asks to confirm first).
ToolTips.Force Logoff Selected Session(s): Log the selected session(s) off immediately - unsaved work is lost. Shows the exact command first.
ToolTips.Scan Selected DCs: Read lockout and bad-password details from the ticked domain controllers.
ToolTips.View Details: Show every field of the selected result.
ToolTips.Copy Key: Copy the selected recovery key to the clipboard.
ToolTips.Copy Password: Copy the LAPS password to the clipboard.
ToolTips.Schedule Restart: Schedule the restart with this delay and message (asks to confirm first).
ToolTips.Select Domain > Connect: Connect to the chosen domain and domain controller.
ToolTips.Include welcome message: Add the New Account Welcome text (Environment > Messages) to the mail.
ToolTips.Environment > Accounts > Browse: Pick the OU from this environment's domain.
ToolTips.Test connection: Try the Domain / DC typed above, without saving or switching to it.
ToolTips.New Account Welcome: Edit the welcome text added to new-account mail.
ToolTips.Clear filters: Empty the search box and every column filter.
ToolTips.Copy selected: Copy the name, phone and email of the selected people to the clipboard.
ToolTips.Export visible: Save every row currently shown to a CSV file.
ToolTips.Export selected: Save the selected rows to a CSV file.
ToolTips.Ignition > Discover Gateways: Probe every server once over HTTP for an Ignition gateway and list what responds. No SMB or admin-share access.
ToolTips.Ignition > Reload Cached: Show the gateways from the last discovery without re-probing anything.
ToolTips.Ignition > Export CSV: Save the discovered gateways to a CSV file.
ToolTips.Ignition > Open Gateway Web Page: Open the gateway home page in your browser.
ToolTips.Ignition > RDP: Open Remote Desktop to the selected server(s).
ToolTips.Tools > Set DNS > Apply DNS Settings: Set the DNS servers on every adapter that is up, on each pasted computer, over WinRM. Shows the exact command first.
